description: This file defines a NestJS guard class 'IsTeamEventTypeWebhookGuard' that enforces access control for team event type webhooks, validating user permissions, team membership, event type existence, and webhook consistency.

classes.name: IsTeamEventTypeWebhookGuard
classes.description: A NestJS guard that verifies user permissions and webhook validity for team event types.

methods.name: canActivate
methods.description: Main method to determine if the request can proceed, validating user, team, event type, and webhook.

methods.name: validateInitialRequest
methods.description: Checks presence of user, teamId, and eventTypeId, throwing exceptions if missing.

methods.name: validateTeamMembership
methods.description: Verifies if the user has admin or owner membership in the team.

methods.name: validateAndGetEventType
methods.description: Fetches and validates the event type for the team.

methods.name: validateAndGetWebhook
methods.description: Fetches and validates the webhook, ensuring it matches the event type.
